compiled_state.description:
## Testing Mode
UPDATE

## Story DD Coverage
This task is responsible for satisfying the following story done definitions:
- DD1: A deliberate test PR with gh pr merge --auto queued confirms the PR remains in BLOCKED mergeStateStatus until each required check reports a green conclusion

Note: DD2 (gh pr merge --squash rejects) is COVERED BY EXISTING Phase 2 test_ruleset_blocks_failing_pr in test-ci-enforcement-e2e.sh. T1 also moves --auto queuing to before checks, completing DD2's 'with --auto queued' requirement.

## Implementation

File: tests/scripts/test-ci-enforcement-e2e.sh (modify, inside RUN_CI_E2E=1 guard)

1. Move `gh pr merge '$CONFORMING_PR_URL' --auto --squash` from after-_poll_checks to immediately after PR creation (before `_poll_checks`)
2. Poll `gh pr view '$CONFORMING_PR_URL' --json mergeStateStatus` for up to 60s looking for BLOCKED_BY_REQUIRED_STATUS_CHECK
3. Assertion logic (falsifiable):
   - If BLOCKED state observed: `_pass 'test_pr_blocked_mergestate_observed'`
   - If polling window closes before BLOCKED seen (checks already green): `_skip 'test_pr_blocked_mergestate_observed'` with msg: "Phase 1b: checks completed before BLOCKED window could be observed — mergeStateStatus verification skipped (not a failure)"
   - A _skip outcome is recorded in output but does NOT increment PASSED or FAILED, making the test result clearly "unverified" rather than "verified"
4. Continue to existing `_poll_checks` call (checks may have already completed)

Gate 2 confirmation: T1 modifies the test file exclusively inside the RUN_CI_E2E=1 guard block. `bash tests/run-all.sh` (the standard suite) does NOT execute opt-in E2E tests. Committing T1 alone leaves `bash tests/run-all.sh` green.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Unit tests pass (exit 0)
  Verify: bash tests/run-all.sh
- [ ] Lint passes (exit 0)
  Verify: ruff check plugins/dso/scripts/*.py tests/**/*.py
- [ ] Format check passes (exit 0)
  Verify: ruff format --check plugins/dso/scripts/*.py tests/**/*.py
- [ ] Phase 1b polls mergeStateStatus field
  Verify: grep -q 'mergeStateStatus' tests/scripts/test-ci-enforcement-e2e.sh
- [ ] test_pr_blocked_mergestate_observed present in script
  Verify: grep -q 'test_pr_blocked_mergestate_observed' tests/scripts/test-ci-enforcement-e2e.sh
- [ ] _skip sentinel (not _pass) used when BLOCKED window missed
  Verify: grep -qE '_skip.*test_pr_blocked_mergestate_observed|test_pr_blocked_mergestate_observed.*_skip' tests/scripts/test-ci-enforcement-e2e.sh
- [ ] gh pr merge --auto queued before _poll_checks (Phase 1b ordering)
  Verify: python3 -c "txt = open('tests/scripts/test-ci-enforcement-e2e.sh').read(); auto_pos = txt.find('pr merge'); poll_pos = txt.find('_poll_checks'); assert auto_pos < poll_pos, 'auto-merge must appear before _poll_checks'; print('OK')"
- [ ] Cleanup trap covers conforming PR and branch
  Verify: grep -qE 'CLEANUP_BRANCH_CONFORMING|CLEANUP_PR_CONFORMING' tests/scripts/test-ci-enforcement-e2e.sh
- [ ] T1 is inside RUN_CI_E2E=1 guard block
  Verify: python3 -c "txt = open('tests/scripts/test-ci-enforcement-e2e.sh').read(); guard_pos = txt.find('RUN_CI_E2E'); blocked_pos = txt.find('mergeStateStatus'); assert guard_pos < blocked_pos, 'mergeStateStatus poll must be inside RUN_CI_E2E guard'; print('OK')"

## Retry Budget
MAX_ATTEMPTS: 3 (sonnet model)
On 3 consecutive sonnet failures: escalate to opus with full diagnostic context (all 3 failure messages)
On 3 consecutive opus failures (6 total): escalate to user with full failure history
If MAX_AGENTS: 0 at sonnet->opus escalation time: skip opus step, escalate to user immediately

comments.body:
AC amendment: Handle fast-CI auto-merge race in Phase 1b polling

During the mergeStateStatus poll loop (up to 60s), the conforming PR may auto-merge before a BLOCKED state is observed. Amend T1 to:
(a) During the poll loop, if 'state=MERGED' is returned from gh pr view --json state, emit _skip 'test_pr_blocked_mergestate_observed' with log 'PR auto-merged before BLOCKED window observed — Phase 1b skipped' and break out of the poll loop immediately.
(b) After Phase 1b completes, check whether the conforming PR is still open before proceeding to the existing _poll_checks call. If the PR is already in MERGED state (auto-merged during Phase 1b), skip _poll_checks and test_conforming_pr_merges and emit _skip for those assertions (the auto-merge satisfies the intent).

Additional AC verify:
- [ ] poll loop handles state=MERGED early exit (does not hang after PR merges)
  Verify: grep -qE 'state.*MERGED|MERGED.*state' tests/scripts/test-ci-enforcement-e2e.sh
